data.name: The Callahan Curse
data.detailed_description:
Young Gabriella leaves home on an Adventure to discover her past, and face a growing darkness that now threatens her once peaceful land.  After her caretaker is suddenly transformed into a mysterious "Black Swan", Gabriella is on a quest to find the elusive, "Elise", who may hold the key to overcoming the darkness.  Join Gabriella as she ventures toward unknown lands beyond the horizon, offering aide to strangers and friends along the way, giving help and receiving help in return, ultimately to confront the darkness once and for all, and heal the wounds of a fallen kingdom.

The Callahan Curse explores themes of sacrifice, family love, connection, and facing the dangers in our own lives with faith and determination. 

The Callahan Curse was created by solo developer, Artist Composer - Isaac Lundgren, who has been active in the adventure game community for many years, and who currently works as a public school Art and Design instructor for a local high school.  This 2D Point and Click Fantasy Adventure game features Hand Painted backgrounds, 2D Animated characters, hand-composed original music, original story, and fully voiced characters!  A passion project, more than 20 years in production!  Inspired by the Golden Age of Adventure Gaming from the late 80's-90's, The Callahan Curse is sure to bring you back to that fantasy land of yesteryear to go on a new adventure of your own.  Come and Play, The Callahan Curse!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD FX-4350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 or AMD Radeon HD 7750 (1 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R9 280 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 16 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or higher (64-bit required)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (Dual-Core, 2.5 GHz) or Apple Silicon M1 base chip
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus Graphics 640 or AMD Radeon Pro 555 (1 GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or higher (64-bit required)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 (Quad-Core) or Apple Silicon M1 / M2 / M3
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Pro 560 (2 GB VRAM) or Integrated Apple Silicon GPU
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
